title: My “I’ll Come Back to This” Collection
excerpt: Papers, articles, and anything else worth saving, a living list of things I keep coming back to.

title: Spring Boot Ultra: Main Character Energy for Your Backend
excerpt: The ultra Spring Boot textbook - Parts I–XXI with deep lessons, matrices, mermaid diagrams, labs, architect chapters (starters, Actuator, security, GraphQL, SSL, JdbcClient, CRaC), plus a 972-topic atlas with official docs links.

title: It's Lucene All the Way Down
excerpt: A proper Elasticsearch course - teach Lucene guts, search, analytics, lifecycle, vectors, and ops with worked examples and official elastic.co docs links on every topic. Not a flashcard deck.

title: Know the JVM, My Brother. Offers Follow.
excerpt: A thousand Q&As on JVM guts - memory, GC, concurrency, proxies, classloading - and the basics that still break production. Built for revision, not fluff.

title: ArwenForge: Profile-Based RBAC for Multi-Agent MCP Servers
excerpt: One MCP endpoint, many agents. ArwenForge tags tools, resources, prompts, and delegates with profiles — then enforces least-privilege discovery and fail-closed execution on the JVM.

title: docube-db: Zero-Infra Code Lookup via Prefix Pruning
excerpt: A small Java library that finds the right invoice, serial, or part code when the input is almost right using a chunk trie to prune and Levenshtein to rank. Open source on GitHub.

title: State It. Cache It. Ace It. A Dynamic Programming Guide.
excerpt: A 7-day roadmap from recursion and memoization through knapsack, tree DP, bitmask DP, and interval DP - with curated LeetCode problems and contest-ready patterns.

title: Everything you need to know about LangChain and LangGraph
excerpt: This post takes you from "what is an LLM API?" to production agents - step by step, no prior knowledge assumed.

title: One Change Breaks Everything? Five SOLID Principles Fix That
excerpt: A deep-dive into all five SOLID principles with real-world analogies, bad vs. good code comparisons, and complete Java examples. Learn how to write clean, maintainable, and extensible software that your future self will thank you for.

title: Design Patterns Hiding in Your Code - All of Them, Explained
excerpt: A deep-dive into all 23 GoF design patterns - Creational, Structural, and Behavioral, explained with real-world analogies, UML intent, and complete Java code examples. Your one-stop reference for writing better, scalable software.

title: Embabel Agent Framework: Build Smarter AI Agents on the JVM
